edits.old: ### 8. Business rules
edits.new:
Scenario: AC6 Each secret is resolved at run time from its key-store reference, and no code, configuration file or prompt holds the value (BR1) (new, D-RCV-60)

Scenario: AC7 A service reads only its own key-store path, and a read of another service's path is denied by the key store (BR2) (new, D-RCV-60)

Scenario: AC8 The key store holds the Temporal payload codec key per namespace, and no two namespaces share one codec key (BR3) (new, D-RCV-60)

Scenario: AC9 A threshold, limit or name resolves through the parameters contract and a list through the reference-data contract, with no such value in code (BR4) (new, D-RCV-60)

Scenario: AC10 A non-secret environment setting comes from the environment variables and the chart values of its environment, and the chart holds no secret (BR5) (new, D-RCV-60)

Scenario: AC11 The pipeline blocks a change that carries a secret, personal data in code, tests or logs, or an unapproved dependency (BR6) (new, D-RCV-60)

Scenario: AC12 A rotation writes a new key-store version with no rebuild, and the old credential is refused after the overlap window (BR7) (new, D-RCV-60)

Scenario: AC13 Personal data stays in the owning service, masked, and does not appear in an event, a workflow payload or a log (BR8) (new, D-RCV-60)

Scenario: AC14 Every call between services is mutually authenticated with the calling workload identity, and authorisation is deny by default (BR9) (new, D-RCV-60)

### 8. Business rules

edits.old: | TC-PLT-NF04-OPS-05 | AC5 | Integration | A rotation in DEV and SIT: a new key-store version is written, the running service reads it at run time with no rebuild, no new image and no chart change; the previous version is readable only for the overlap window; after the window, a call with the old credential is refused and the service still serves calls with the current version |
edits.new:
| TC-PLT-NF04-OPS-05 | AC5 | Integration | A rotation in DEV and SIT: a new key-store version is written, the running service reads it at run time with no rebuild, no new image and no chart change; the previous version is readable only for the overlap window; after the window, a call with the old credential is refused and the service still serves calls with the current version |
| TC-PLT-NF04-OPS-06 | AC6 | Component | A clone of the template repository with a secret reference in a configuration file and a build that reads it; the scan finds no secret value in the code, the configuration file or the prompt; the reference resolves at run time in DEV |
| TC-PLT-NF04-OPS-07 | AC7 | Integration | Two service identities each read their own key-store path and are allowed; one identity asks for another service's path and is denied; the denial is logged with the asking identity and the requested path |
| TC-PLT-NF04-OPS-08 | AC8 | Component | Two namespaces each with one codec key in the key store; a client of one namespace fails to decode a payload written under the other namespace |
| TC-PLT-NF04-OPS-09 | AC9 | Component | A change with a literal threshold or a literal list value in code fails; the same value read through the parameters contract or the reference-data contract passes |
| TC-PLT-NF04-OPS-10 | AC10 | Component | The chart values of DEV carry only non-secret settings; a secret value placed in the chart values fails the gate; the environment variable resolves to the setting of its environment |
| TC-PLT-NF04-OPS-11 | AC11 | NFR | A change with a personal-data field in a log statement and a change with an unapproved dependency each block before merge; a clean change passes |
| TC-PLT-NF04-OPS-12 | AC12 | Integration | A rotation writes a new key-store version; the service reads it with no rebuild; after the overlap window the old credential is refused |
| TC-PLT-NF04-OPS-13 | AC13 | Component | A personal-data field in an event, a workflow payload and a log is masked or refused; the field stays in the owning service |
| TC-PLT-NF04-OPS-14 | AC14 | Integration | A call between two services presents the calling workload identity over mTLS and is accepted; a call with no listed identity is denied by default |
